Any such row censors open same-market windows and blocks new anchors/qualifications from that message through receipt+2.4s; keep tracking otherwise valid identities during quarantine. Resume afterward only with fresh valid data. Timestamp-future, malformed identity, source regression, unknown market/channel/generation and existing strict errors retain v1 fatal suppression. No other delay/spacing/candidate changes.
semantics: First seen means first in retained observations, not actual order birth or complete exchange history. Both source and receipt must still be strictly after anchor+400ms and <=anchor+2.4s for a first-observed distinct order. Initial-message keys/history excluded. Cross-array deduplication and every v1 identity limit retained.
motivation: One otherwise-valid old timestamp does not erase previously retained identities. Quarantine gives a new full observation window after the late evidence. This is a distinct measurement method proposed from source logic and v1 coverage failures; original v1 remains immutable.
decision: Report admitted/censored/quarantined/suppressed evidence and delayed witnesses in every fixed block/cell. A supported next comparison requires >=10 complete witnessed episodes per same asset/venue in each of the two prespecified superblocks (batches1-3 and4-6), each represented in>=2 constituent blocks. Direction counts remain explicit; no pooled-cell rescue. This is a design support threshold, not power or profit.
